en.headline: Wong Tai Sin Hospital flu cluster grows by 14 cases; three elderly men die
en.dek: Hospital Authority says six more male patients in the chest ward, seven female patients in the convalescent ward and one staff member tested positive for influenza A; three men aged 81 to 95 with serious underlying…
body: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals Wong Tai Sin Hospital reported a further 14 influenza A cases linked to an earlier cluster in its chest and convalescent wards, the Hospital Authority said on Monday evening.

Contact tracing identified six additional male patients aged 63 to 95 in the chest ward, seven female patients aged 55 to 85 in the convalescent ward, and one staff member who developed fever and respiratory symptoms. All tested positive for influenza A. Three of the male patients, aged 81 to 95 and all with serious underlying diseases, died. The remaining ten patients are stable in isolation and the staff member is on leave.

The hospital said it had stepped up cleaning and disinfection of the affected wards, reinforced hand hygiene for staff and patients, and enforced droplet precautions. The cases have been reported to the Hospital Authority head office and the Centre for Health Protection.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院甲流群組再增14人 3名有嚴重疾病男病人離世
zh.dek: 醫管局指胸肺科病房再有6名男病人、療養病房7名女病人及1名職員確診甲型流感，其中3名81至95歲男病人因嚴重自身疾病離世，其餘情況穩定。
body: 東華三院黃大仙醫院周一晚公布，早前胸肺科及療養病房出現的甲型流感病毒個案組群，經接觸追蹤調查後再發現14宗新個案。
新增個案包括6名入住胸肺科病房的男病人（63至95歲）、7名入住療養病房的女病人（55至85歲）及1名職員，均出現發燒及呼吸道感染徵狀，經化驗對甲型流感病毒呈陽性。當中3名81至95歲男病人全部有嚴重自身疾病，其後離世；其餘10名病人正接受隔離治療，情況穩定，職員則休假。
院方表示已按指引加強清潔消毒相關病房、員工及病人手部衞生，以及嚴格執行飛沫防護措施，並已向醫管局總辦事處及衞生防護中心呈報。
